How it works

One enquiry. One host. One plan.

  1. 01

    Tell us the trip

    Share your dates, your group and what a good day in the mountains looks like for you, on snow or off it.

  2. 02

    Receive one clear plan

    We bring coaching, lodging, dining, transfers and experiences together in one tailored proposal.

  3. 03

    Travel hosted

    One point of contact before the trip and on the mountain, from arrival to the last run.

Who hosts you

A small team that knows the mountains.

EverFlow was founded in 2022 by Juan Rodrigo Fernandez, a former member of the Argentinian Ski Team. We host in English, Spanish and Portuguese, with German-speaking instructors and partners.

Good to know

Before we plan the first day.

Where do you operate?

Across the Alps: in Switzerland, Austria, France, Italy and Germany. And in Las Leñas, in the Argentine Andes, for the southern winter. See all destinations.

What can a trip include?

Private coaching, hotels and chalets, dining, wellness, guiding and transfers. Every part is optional: some guests come for a single lesson, others for a full week we handle from start to finish.

Do I need a finished plan to get in touch?

No. Start with whatever you know, a date, a group or an idea of the day, and we come back with the questions that matter and one clear proposal.

Which languages do you host in?

English, Spanish and Portuguese, with German-speaking instructors and partners across the Alps.

Do you show prices?

No. Every trip is planned for you, so we send a proposal with the costs once we know your dates, your group and what you want to do.
